stages.name: 1. Validated tool for labs and small teams

stage_rule: Stage one carries all lab equipment and lab running costs. Other shared costs are split by people cost, and contingency is added to each stage. Each stage starts only if the one before it is paying. Repayment leaves out running, support and sales costs after the build, and assumes customers from day one. The number of paying teams in India has not been sized.
